what: Wall time of one compile of test/error.cpp to an object file with a precompiled header, and wall time of the build of that header. Arm std: a header of the standard library headers that include/cbor includes directly, and doctest. Arm cbor: <cbor/cbor.hpp> and doctest, as the PCH list of CMakeLists.txt. Arm cbor_aa: a copy of arm cbor in its own directory, for the A/A noise floor.
how: One container, one compile at a time, each arm in its own build directory, 2 rounds, order std cbor cbor_aa in round 1 and cbor_aa cbor std in round 2. Direct g++ calls with the flags and defines of the gcc-asan iter build (the form that CMake gives a target with a PCH: -include cmake_pch.hxx -Winvalid-pch). No ccache (CCACHE_DISABLE=1). The probe script lies outside the tree; it is not committed.
result: Arm cbor compiles test/error.cpp in less time than arm std; the difference of the medians is greater than the A/A difference. Arm std builds its header in less time.
